channel.title: MOLOCH.SH · daily briefing
channel.description: The AI-race news that the observatory detects every day, chosen with a fixed rule. Figures from OpenRouter, Artificial Analysis, Epoch AI, Hugging Face and METR, with their source.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon becomes the best closed model on the AA index
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon becomes the best closed model in the catalogue on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5: 59.4 points, 1 more than Claude Opus 5.5 (58.4). It has no public API yet: it is not on OpenRouter. The gap between the best closed and the best open-weight model on the AA index stands at 13.4 points (12.4 the day before). It does not equate to months of lag. It is in the briefing because the best closed model changes with the same AA index version and a margin of 1 points (minimum 1). Detected on 2026-10-29. Source: Artificial Analysis (https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/gemini-4-carbon). Artificial Analysis data (https://artificialanalysis.ai), published with its permission.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon (Google) enters the AA index at rank 1, still without a public API
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon (Google) appears scored on Artificial Analysis with 59.4 points, still without a public API: it is not on OpenRouter. AA index 59.4: 1 points above the previous best closed model (Claude Opus 5.5). Rank 1 of 29. It is not on OpenRouter yet: no public API and no price. It is in the briefing because it is a new model and enters the top 20 of the AA index (rank 1 of 29). Published on 2026-10-28; detected on 2026-10-29. Source: Artificial Analysis (https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/gemini-4-carbon). Artificial Analysis data (https://artificialanalysis.ai), published with its permission.

item.title: DeepSeek halves the price of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
item.description: DeepSeek cuts the price of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 on OpenRouter: input from $0.3 to $0.15 and output from $1.2 to $0.6 per million tokens. Its blended price on OpenRouter goes from $0.525 to $0.262 per million tokens. It is in the briefing because the lab itself cuts its blended price by 50% (threshold: +50% or −33%). Detected on 2026-10-29. Source: OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017/providers).

item.title: Artificial Analysis launches version 5 of its Intelligence Index
item.description: Artificial Analysis moves its Intelligence Index from version 4.3 to 5: scores from the two versions are not comparable. It is in the briefing because Artificial Analysis changes the version of its index. Detected on 2026-10-28. Source: Artificial Analysis (https://artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models). item.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro becomes the best open-weight model on the AA index
item.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro becomes the best open-weight model in the catalogue on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3: 55.1 points, 8.8 more than MiMo-V2.6-Pro (46.3). Its weights have been announced by the lab, but cannot be downloaded yet. The gap between the best closed and the best open-weight model on the AA index stands at 2.5 points (11.3 the day before). item.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 becomes the most used model on OpenRouter
item.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 becomes the most used model on OpenRouter over the last 7 days (14.9% of tokens), ahead of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. 14.9% of OpenRouter’s tokens from 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-23; before, the first was deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20260910. This is usage on OpenRouter, not across the whole market. It is in the briefing because the most used model on OpenRouter over the last 7 days changes. Published on 2026-10-23; detected on 2026-10-24. Source: OpenRouter · usage (https://openrouter.ai/rankings).

item.title: Minimax starts charging for MiniMax M3.1 Flash on OpenRouter
item.description: Minimax starts charging for MiniMax M3.1 Flash on OpenRouter: $0.15 input and $0.6 output per million tokens. Until now it was free. Its blended price on OpenRouter goes from free to $0.262 per million tokens. Of the 10 models with a similar AA index (±2 points of its 42.7), 3 cost less; the cheapest is Ling 3.1 Flash, at $0.112. It is in the briefing because the lab itself starts charging for it on OpenRouter, where it was free. Detected on 2026-10-23. Source: OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash/providers). Artificial Analysis data (https://artificialanalysis.ai), published with its permission.
